title: Hutang Naik Balik
notes: Source of truth for Episode 9 (rework). Night-training motif: Azam's extra drills under floodlights, then the pylon blows and the pitch is shut until the club pays. Bos makes the call he swore he never would; even the lawyer softens one degree for the kids. Lights blaze again, debt spikes RM296,500 -> RM321,500, and Azam vows to repay the lamps with a trophy.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Latihan Malam & Letupan
scenes.visual: Frame 0: night training in full floodlight — Azam's drill squad moving. Mid-scene the hero tower blows: sparks, smoke, blackness, silence. Danial's panic, Jurulatih's bad news, and the narrator's ultimatum: pay twenty-five grand before matchday four or forfeit.
scenes.sfx: electrical pop + sparks at the explosion; empty-night ambience; bass-hit on the blackout.

events.note: First cut within the hook window.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Sepuluh malam latihan extra. Lampu terang.
lines.translation: Ten nights of extra training. Floodlights blazing.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Lagi sekali! Blok, halau, langkah balik!

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Tiang letup. Padang tutup sampai kita bayar.
lines.translation: The pylon blew. Pitch closed until we pay.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dua puluh lima ribu. Atau forfeit.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Telefon yang Bos Tak Nak Call
scenes.visual: The office at its lowest. Bos lifts the phone to the one name he hoped never to call again. The Peguam's cold proverb lands — but one degree warmer: the kids training at night earned that loan. Bos vows it is the last call he will ever make.
scenes.sfx: phone ring + pickup; pen-tap on the terms; low office drone.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Peguam. Lampu kelab aku mati. Top-up satu lagi.
lines.translation: Lawyer. My club's lights are dead. One more top-up.

lines.speaker: PEGUAM
lines.text: Satu langkah depan, dua langkah belakang, bos.
lines.translation: One step forward, two steps back, boss.

lines.speaker: PEGUAM
lines.text: Tapi budak-budak kau latihan malam. Duit aku hantar esok.
lines.translation: But your kids training at night? The money goes out tomorrow.

scenes.name: Act 3 — Lampu Balik, Hutang Naik
scenes.visual: Two days later: the floodlights blaze again over the same penalty box, fully lit. The squad stares up at the lamps they now owe. Azam asks the question, Bos owns the answer, and Azam makes the season's promise: these lights get paid back with a trophy. DebtTickerHUD slams RED RM296,500 -> RM321,500.
scenes.sfx: floodlamp hum up; pen-tap ticks with the HUD; bass-hit on the red spike.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dua hari lepas. Lampu balik. Hutang pun naik.
lines.translation: Two days later. The lights are back. So is the debt.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.translation: These lights cost a fortune, right, boss?

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Mahal. Tapi sebab korang nak belajar, aku bayar.
lines.translation: Expensive. But you wanted to learn, so I paid.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Lampu ni kita bayar balik... dengan trofi.
lines.translation: We'll pay these lights back… with a trophy.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: RM321,500. Tapi kelab ni tak mudah mati.
lines.translation: RM321,500. But this club does not die easily.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 9 card. No CTA.
